rules.raw_text: Protect housing, groceries, medicine, and transportation. Never extend a loan if it adds interest. Ask me before pausing any subscription.
rules.trigger: Any candidate intervention affecting an obligation in a protected category, adding loan interest, or pausing a subscription.

starter_rules.raw_text: You may pause subscriptions under $25.00 automatically when my essential reserve is at risk.
starter_rules.trigger: Essential reserve violation projected and at least one active subscription under $25.00.

starter_rules.raw_text: Allow Relief to request provider negotiation on my behalf up to $50.00 in added flexibility, but always ask before approving.
starter_rules.trigger: A candidate intervention requires provider approval and stays within the $50.00 limit.
